scripts.build:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary:darwin && pnpm run esbuild
scripts.build-dev:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-dev:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-dev && pnpm run build-types
scripts.build-prod:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-prod:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-prod
scripts.buildBinary-prod:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/Textractor' ]; then rm bin/Textractor; fi && swift build -c release --package-path src/swift/Textractor && cp src/swift/Textractor/.build/release/Textractor bin/Textractor && shasum -a 256 bin/Textractor > dist/Textractor.sha256
scripts.buildBinary-dev:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/Textractor' ]; then rm bin/Textractor; fi && swift build -c debug --package-path src/swift/Textractor && cp src/swift/Textractor/.build/debug/Textractor bin/dev/Textractor && shasum -a 256 bin/dev/Textractor > dist/Textractor.sha256
